release_notes: First Comment Autopilot now watches newly scheduled full YouTube quizzes and automatically posts the prepared first comment after YouTube confirms the video is public.
Before posting, the app reuses the existing remote comment-dedupe check, so an existing comment from the connected Factburst channel is recorded instead of duplicated.
The watchdog runs shortly after startup and every five minutes while the app is open, and continues watching future releases across app restarts.
Build 43 avoids retroactive back-catalogue commenting by activating only for new/future scheduled releases, with a small grace window for a quiz that has just gone live.
